I don't have Costco's reported cash flow for the full fiscal 2026 year (ending about August 30, 2026), so this is an estimate rather than a reported figure.

- Costco's fiscal 2025 net cash provided by operating activities was about $13.3 billion.
- I assumed fiscal 2026 growth of roughly 8–10%, which gives about $14.4–14.7 billion for the year.
- Dividing by four quarters gives an average of roughly $3.6 billion per quarter.

Costco's 10-Qs report cash flow cumulatively, so individual quarters vary. The first quarter has 12 weeks and the others have 12 or 16, but the annual average is still the full-year total divided by four.
